blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) has identified a person of interest in the killing of a 50-year-old barangay chairman in Batangas on Thursday. Dennis Austria, chairman of Barangay Sta. Anastacia in Sto. Tomas City, was shot dead at his residence. In a press briefing on Friday, PNP public information chief Col. Allen Rae Co showed video footage of Austria cleaning around the terrace at his house in a subdivision at 6:20 a.m. when an armed man shot him.
